title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: Banda’s self-assertion now becomes explicit as he speaks of shaping his own order, making the break with the Khalsa doctrinal rather than merely personal.
He threatens opponents, speaks of Lahore, and presents himself as capable of sustaining a separate panth apart from the Guru’s established discipline.
The phrase separate panth captures the core of the page: estrangement becoming ideological.
